verdict.rationale: cubic can pull context from linked Linear or Jira issues and check whether a PR meets their requirements, which covers the Jira part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows Slack, Google Drive, or a general mechanism for connecting other workflow tools. cubic's MCP server exposes cubic's data to other agents; it does not bring outside context into cubic, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: Slack integration, Google Drive integration, a general way to connect workflow tools as context sources, independent corroboration of the Jira integration.
